name: Robotics Lab
description: The Robotics Laboratory is a place where students learn by building. They work with microcontrollers, sensors, motors, and circuit design, and put them together into working robots. Alongside teaching, the lab develops practical robotic solutions, from custom electronics to control systems. A part of this work uses reinforcement learning (RL) to train robots to handle tasks through trial and error, first in simulation and then on real hardware. The aim is simple: give students hands-on skills in electronics and programming, and create robots that actually work.

name: SDU Data Analytics Lab
description: MADRID Lab (Machine learning, Analytics, Data Research & Intelligent Decisions) is an SDU University research lab that develops data-driven methods to support well-grounded decisions. The lab brings together students and researchers working on real data problems: building models, testing them rigorously, and understanding when results can be trusted. Focus areas: machine learning, analytics, data research, and intelligent decision-making, with applications in clinical prediction, NLP and text analysis, computer vision, HR and learning analytics, and environmental modelling. Students join the lab for research projects, theses and internships.

visitor_walkthrough:
1) Introduction to MADRID Lab -> 1 minute
Briefly introduce the laboratory's mission: Machine Learning, Analytics, Data Research & Intelligent Decisions, and explain how the lab connects student research with real-world data problems.

2) Research areas and team -> 1 minute
Present the main research directions: clinical prediction, NLP and text analysis, learning analytics, computer vision, HR analytics and environmental modelling.

3) Selected research projects -> 2-3 minutes
Present 2–3 representative projects, such as explainable machine learning for arterial hypertension, suicide-risk detection using NLP, and student dropout analytics.

4) Live technical demonstration -> 2-3 minutes
Show a prepared ML pipeline or dashboard using anonymized/sample data: data input → model prediction → model evaluation → explainability/SHAP results.

5) Research output and opportunities -> 1-2 minutes
Show publications, conferences, the laboratory website and GitHub, and briefly explain opportunities for student research, theses, internships and external collaboration.
live_demo:
1. Explainable AI for Clinical Prediction
Demo flow: anonymized/sample clinical data → preprocessing → trained ML model → predicted risk/stage → SHAP-based explanation showing the most influential features → discussion of model validation and data leakage.

2. Student Analytics / Dropout Analysis
Demo flow: anonymized student dataset → overview of key variables → exploratory dashboard → prediction/analysis → identification of important factors → visualization of results.

3. NLP Research Pipeline
Demo flow: sample text → preprocessing/tokenization → NLP model → classification or semantic analysis → visualization/interpretation of model output.

4. MADRID Lab Research Platform
Demo flow: laboratory website → team → research areas → publications → current projects/openings → GitHub repositories.

For visitor demonstrations, prepared synthetic or anonymized datasets should be used instead of sensitive research data.
